children: appears to be taking advantage of the rapid rise of agentic artificial intelligence, launching a new Data agent in ChatGPT Work and introducing the Agents API.
The Data agent can connect to company data and build interactive dashboards to help users analyze business activity all through a single conversation.

"It uses your organization's business terms, metric definitions, custom calculations, and data relationships to interpret the data," OpenAI said. "This context comes from semantic layers and trusted sources such as Databricks Genie Ontology, dbt, GitHub

"Our customers have built a trusted foundation for enterprise data and context in Snowflake," said Umesh Unnikrishnan, head of Developer Experiences at Snowflake. "With the Data agent in ChatGPT Work, employees can tap into that data and access controls to investigate business questions—while OpenAI models simultaneously bring intelligence to experiences like Snowflake CoCo and CoWork."

OpenAI also went a step further, introducing the Agents API, which is available today in public beta. It provides the harness and infrastructure agents require to use tools efficiently and run reliably for days.

"OpenAI hosts and maintains the harness," the company said. "You choose the agent's compute environment: in an OpenAI-managed sandbox, on your own infrastructure, or with one of our sandbox partners. The Agents API gives you a strong foundation for building agents on top of our optimized agent harness and infrastructure, so you can focus on the tools, knowledge, and workflows that make your agent unique."
OpenAI is working with multiple ecosystem partners, which allows users more choice of where to sandbox. This includes Cloudflare
